purpose: One added element over the frozen 20-session baseline: H2 = expanding mean of mature 20-session labels conditioned on the MA200 regime observed at the label's own decision. Same target, grid, maturity pool and stored H0/H1 anchors. Primary comparison H2 - H1 only. Forecast study; no orders, allocation or h combination.

regime_feature.definition: s_t = 1 if adjusted C[t] > mean(adjusted C[t-199..t]) else 0; equality -> 0; defined for t >= 199 (pool start guarantees every pooled j and every grid decision has a regime)
regime_feature.available_at: close t; uses adjusted closes through t only
regime_feature.role: fixed design constant inherited from ladder R2/R3 and predict-v1; not tuned

new_predictor.name: H2_ma200_conditional_mean
new_predictor.formula: at grid decision i: mean of mature labels Y_j (j >= 199, j + 21 <= i) with s_j == s_i
new_predictor.attribution: each matured label j is added at close i = j + 21 to the cell of s_j (the regime at its own decision), never to the current regime
new_predictor.update_order: at close i add Y_j for j = i - 21 to the global sum/count and to cell s_j; if i is on the grid compute s_i, emit H2; off-grid sessions update statistics only; no updates after the last grid decision
new_predictor.fallback: if cell s_i has no mature label: H2 = contemporaneous global mean (must equal stored H1 within 1e-15), count fallback_cell_to_global; if the global pool is empty: 0, count fallback_empty
new_predictor.invariants: n_cell0 + n_cell1 == n_global at every grid decision; n_selected == n_cell[s_i]; empty cell mean is null, not 0
new_predictor.stable_computation: running sums with finite checks (or Welford means); any non-finite statistic or prediction aborts invalid_input

baselines.policy: H0 and H1 loaded verbatim from the pinned predict-h20-v1 artifact per grid decision; outcomes reused from the same artifact; our running global mean compared to stored H1 within 1e-15 and labels to stored outcomes within 1e-15; abort on mismatch

comparisons.primary: mean paired squared-error difference H2 - H1 over the 145 scored blocks, overall and by entry year (12-13 blocks per year, descriptive)
secondary: MSE H2 and ratio to H0 (null if 0)
share of blocks with H2 squared error strictly below H1
uncentered cross moment, centered covariance, sign accuracy (mu != 0, Y != 0) with eligible/zero counts, mu mean / population sd
cell diagnostics at the first and last grid decision: n_cell0, n_cell1, cell means or null, s_i; final pool = last grid decision 2026-10-28, no later labels
fallback and update counts; H2 estimate counts scored/pending (warm-up and off-grid 0)
comparisons.interpretation: descriptive; a difference of either sign is a legitimate outcome; no expected-improvement figure; the regime split is a different sample weighting, not evidence of regime timing

verification_required: synthetic fixture (pool start 1, horizon 3, MA window 2, fixed grid): regimes by hand incl. exact tie -> 0, label attribution to the regime at its own decision, exact Fraction cell means, fallback to global when the current cell is empty, invariants, grid-only storage, pending at the end

perturbation of adjusted C: changing C strictly after k leaves grid forecasts <= k unchanged; changing C[k] can change regimes s_t for every t whose MA window contains k (t in [k, k+window-1]) and thus later label attribution; assert forecasts before k unchanged and that the set of changed regimes is within that range; do not assert later invariance
perturbation of raw O: after k leaves forecasts <= k unchanged; O[k] enters label j = k-21 (numerator) from decision k and label j = k-1 (denominator) from decision k+20, as verified in h20-v1
constant-price full payload: zero targets, null ratios/sign metrics, pending excluded, allow_nan=False
anchor fixtures: alignment pass; rejections for wrong hash, duplicate decision, shifted session, pending flag, n_pool mismatch, H1 mismatch > 1e-15, outcome mismatch
real data: four hashes before and after; calendar facts equal to the stored h20-v1 facts; stored anchor aligned to the grid; no real-data estimation in selftest
single xb write; separate run log (hashes before/after, timeout, exit, wall, stdout/stderr, result hash/bytes); bill reviews the final code hash before one bounded run
